I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-random message: the ticket is #8841.

Tobias posted that in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27). He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841. Pree is in that channel, so she could already see it.

One caveat I gave her: Tobias called it "Tobias's dealer account" and never named Marrow Fieldworks. A team digest from January says Marrow Fieldworks changed hands on Jan 5 and calls it Pree's dealer account. It doesn't say who took it over, but that fits Tobias. I suggested she check with Tobias if she needs the ticket's current status before her call.
